ticks.note: The same chart as loop-bounded-counter, which the default netlist compiler rejects. The priority-based compiler accepts instantaneous loops and runs them: the self-loop fires three times within tick 1 (taken = [3]) and x = 3. If such a loop never ends, the priority-compiled tick never returns and the simulation stops responding.
x < 3 is false now; the loop does not fire. x = 3.
